connections.feedback: Yes. The framers wanted the national government not to depend on any single state. Tutors can link this to the principle of national authority.
The Constitution does not forbid cities inside states. Many national offices are located elsewhere.
The District's leadership is set by Congress and local government. This is not about giving the President control.
Size and population were not the reason. The reason was to keep the seat of government independent of any one state.
